scope: standards axis and stronger-reasoner independent disposition, original judgments retained unmodified

findings.finding: Candidate shared discovery inherits candidate profile whose configured port is the active endpoint. Existing same-token backend passes without candidate-instance identity. When no backend exists, discovery can launch candidate at active endpoint in a separate process group; Rpc close does not stop that owned backend.
findings.standard: CODING_STANDARDS.md: Claims match evidence; a claim is no stronger than code enforces.
findings.falsifier: Prove all candidate discovery paths use an isolated endpoint and token, bind observed backend identity to candidate, and stop only that candidate in a finally block.

findings.finding: Failure after candidate token creation skips token.unlink; retained synthetic copy confirmed mode0600. This is lifecycle cleanup weakness, not an assertion of exposed credentials.
findings.standard: CONTRIBUTING.md: keep private local inputs out of publication; followup safety/reliability finding, not evidence of a tracked secret.
findings.falsifier: Failure paths remove temporary candidate token in finally without touching active token.

findings.finding: Actual shared-client registration removes Claude entry then adds it. Synthetic add failure after successful removal leaves entry absent while machine config is restored. Existing rollback test patches registration wholesale and covers config only.
findings.standard: CODING_STANDARDS.md Tests: meaningful negative control for failure being claimed. Documentation promises config restoration only; classify broader client rollback as reliability followup, not falsification of that narrow promise.
findings.falsifier: A negative control restores captured shared client entries after a remove/add failure or makes per-entry replacement transactional.

findings.finding: Activation assumes any backend.pid means running and does not check liveness; synthetic stale file refuses activation. Fail-safe maintenance friction; no unsafe activation reproduced.
findings.standard: CODING_STANDARDS.md Claims match evidence: diagnostic says running while only file presence known.
findings.falsifier: Check process liveness and owned launcher identity before diagnosing running backend.
